title: Warn Your Family, and Rely on Allah

paragraphs.text: The Prophet is told not to call upon any other deity along with Allah, because then he would be among those who are punished. He is also told to warn his closest relatives. He should be gentle and humble toward the believers who follow him, which is described as lowering his wing for them. If they disobey him, he should say that he has nothing to do with what they are doing. He must place his trust in the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. Allah sees him when he stands up in prayer, and He sees his movements among those who bow down in prostration. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

Next, the surah tells us upon whom the devils come down. They come down upon every sinful liar. These liars pass on things they have heard, and most of them do not tell the truth. The poets are also described here. Only people who have gone astray follow them. They wander in every valley, and they say things that they do not actually do. However, there is an exception. Some poets believe, do good deeds and remember Allah often, and they defend the Muslims after they have been wronged. As for the wrongdoers, they will soon know what kind of end they are going to.

A new surah begins with the letters Ta and Seen. These are the verses of the Quran and of a clear Book. It was sent as guidance and as good news for the believers, so that they may find the right way and feel hope.
